verdict.rationale: Only community evidence supports Apple Silicon acceleration. One commenter notes Ollama moving from llama.cpp to native MLX on Mac, and a hands-on M4 Pro benchmark shows big tokens/sec gains with nvfp4 and int4 formats; an older report of slow MacBook Pro performance is a single anecdote, not a concrete rebuttal of a vendor claim. missing for 10: first-party documentation of Apple Silicon/ARM and Metal/MLX acceleration, an explicit mention of Metal optimizations, and corroborated benchmarks against CPU or alternatives.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: User benchmark on M4 Pro 48GB: qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q4_K_M eval rate 30.0, nvfp4 66.5, int4 84.4 tokens/sec via 'ollama run' with --verbose.
Ollama was basically shelling out to llama.cpp on mac before
